get.summary: Catalog sources and their last sync.

post.summary: Adds a catalog source. The operator syncs and verifies it.

delete.summary:
Removes a catalog source, the challenges installed from it and their
running instances (D43).

put.summary:
Installs a challenge from a catalog source, or moves it to another
version. The operator verifies the package against the trust policy of
the source and its permissions against the platform policy.

delete.summary: Removes a challenge and stops its running instances (D43). Scores stay.

get.summary: Packages listed by every catalog source, with what is installed.

post.summary: Creates an account with a generated password, returned once.

delete.summary: Deletes an account with its progress and scores, and stops its instances.

patch.summary:
Changes a user's display name, role or state. Admins cannot change their
own role or disable themselves, so there is always an admin left.

post.summary: Gives a user a new generated password, returned once, and ends their sessions.
Signs in with a local account.

get.summary:
Where the provider sends the browser back: signs the user in, creating
their account at the first sign-in.

parameters.name: error
parameters.description: Set by the provider when the sign-in failed or was refused.

200.description: Signed in: a page continuing to the next path

303.description: Back to the login page with an error

get.summary: Starts a single sign-on: redirects the browser to the provider.

parameters.name: next
parameters.description: Local path to open after signing in (default `/`).

get.summary: Installed challenges, with the user's progress.
A challenge, with its instructions and tasks.
Classrooms the user joined, with their assignments and the user's progress.

Server-sent events of the signed-in user (instances and checks). See the
`Event` schema.

post.summary: Starts a challenge. A user has one active instance at a time.

delete.summary: Stops an instance. Everything in it is lost; scores are kept.

get.summary: The latest check of an instance.

post.summary: Checks every task of an instance. Results arrive as events.
Opens a terminal: returns the gateway URL with a short-lived token.

get.summary: What an invite link leads to. No sign-in needed.

post.summary: Joins the classroom of an invite link.

Creates a student account through an invite link, joins the classroom
and signs in.

get.summary: The signed-in user and their score.

post.summary: Changes the signed-in user's password and ends their other sessions.

get.summary: How the platform is set up, for the web UI (no sign-in needed).
Classrooms the teacher manages (every classroom for admins).

post.summary: Creates a classroom owned by the teacher, with its invite link on.

get.summary: A classroom with its members and assignments.

delete.summary:
Deletes a classroom with its memberships and assignments. Accounts and
scores are kept.

patch.summary:
Renames a classroom, turns its invite link on or off, or (admins) gives
it to another teacher.

put.summary: Assigns an installed challenge to a classroom, or changes its dates.

post.summary: Replaces the invite code: the old link stops working.

delete.summary: Removes a member from a classroom (their account and scores are kept).

get.summary: Returns the version of the api.

AssignmentView.description: A challenge assigned to a classroom.

title.description: The challenge's title, when it is still installed.

lastSync.description: RFC 3339 time of the last successful sync.

managedByChart.description:
Installed by the Helm chart (the official catalog): removing it here
lasts until the next upgrade, unless the chart values disable it.

message.description: Why the source is not ready, or what the last sync found.

packages.description: Packages listed by the last verified index.

ready.description: The last sync verified the index.

ref.description: OCI reference of the catalog index.

ChallengeDetail.description: A challenge with its instructions and tasks.

estimatedMinutes.description: Typical time to solve, in minutes.

runnable.description: False when this cluster cannot run the challenge.

solvedPoints.description: Points the user has already scored.

CheckPhase.description: Lifecycle phase of a check run.

newlySolved.description: Tasks this run solved for the first time.

ClassroomChange.description: Fields to change; missing fields are kept.

ownerId.description: New owner, a teacher or an admin (admins only).

ClassroomDetail.description: A classroom with its members and assignments, for its teacher.

ClassroomView.description: A classroom, as its teacher sees it.

inviteEnabled.description: When false, the invite link does not work (members stay).

username.description: Lowercase letters, digits, `.`, `_` and `-`, up to 64 characters.

CreatedUser.description: A new account and its generated password, shown once.

oneOf.description: An instance of the user changed.

activeInstances.description: Instances that removing the challenge would stop.

message.description: What the operator says about the installation.

mirrored.description: The package and its images are in the in-cluster registry mirror.

requestedVersion.description: Version asked for, for catalog installs (may not be installed yet).

sourceKind.description: Where it comes from: catalog, oci or inline (development).

message.description: Why the instance is in its phase (progress, failure reason...).

Joined.description: The result of joining through an invite link.

joined.description: False when the user was a member already.

MarketplaceEntry.description: A package offered by a catalog source.

oneOf.description:
The installed challenge of the same name, if any (from this source or
another one).

updateAvailable.description: A newer version than the installed one is listed by this source.

sso.description: Signs in with single sign-on (no local password).

name.description: Name of the source (a DNS label).

machine.description: Machine of one of the challenge's terminals.

The provider's groups decide roles at every sign-in, so role changes
